entries.name: Ninkai
entries.content:
In the year 2091, a biotech company named KairoSyn, accidentally let loose a nano parasyte, that  infected people all over the world. The infected had their genomes modified, turning into creatures that belonged more into a myth, than real life. This modified humans, got the label of Ninkai. Once they became infected, their oofpirng where born with the same characteristics than their parents, thus creating a new sub species of humans. 

Races of Ninkai know to date:
Nekomata
Kitsune
Okami
Konchū 
Orochi
Amabie 
Oni

entries.name: Corporations
entries.content:
these are corporations so large and powerfull they hold influence around the world simiar o that of a country.

The biggest 5 are:
KairoSyn: Synthetic evolution, derived from kairos (critical moment).
SomaTek: Named after the mythical drug Soma, offers enhancements with a cost.
Zaibatek International: Neo-Zaibatsu with influence over politics and tech.
Shinkuro Heavy Systems: One foot in war, one in infrastructure. 
HexaCorp: Six divisions, zero moral oversight.

Other notable corps:
ONI.bio: Publicly branded as “Organic Neural Integration,” secretly experimenting on oni.

entries.name: KairoSyn
entries.content:
Company Overview:
Kairosyn began as a biotech startup focused on evolutionary acceleration through parasitic symbiosis—using engineered biological agents to rapidly adapt the human body for extreme environments, warfare, or even immortality.

They promised “the next leap in human potential.”

What they created was the Kairos Parasite (internal codename: Y-MORPH).

KairoSyn accidentally tapped into “mythogenetic encoding”—a theorized biological mechanism in humans that responds to cultural mythos under stress or mutation. The parasite acted as a biological amplifier, reshaping hosts into physical forms inspired by subconscious archetypes… namely, yōkai. The affected individuals where labeled, Ninkai.

entries.name: SomaTek
entries.content:
SomaTek is one of the most pervasive and omnipresent corporations in Neo-Japan. It's a pharmaceutical empire masquerading as a benevolent health and wellness provider. On the surface, it’s about improving lives—student focus pills, sleep enhancers, mood stabilizers. Behind closed doors, it’s a factory for human augmentation, behavioral control, and military-grade bio-enhancements.

They have public labs, clinical pop-up kiosks, neural therapy clinics, and a huge presence in both consumer-grade supplements and classified military research.

entries.name: ZaibaTek
entries.content:
Company Overview
Zaibatek International is the most powerful and elusive megacorporation in the cyberpunk world. With tendrils in tech, pharmaceuticals, defense, surveillance, banking, genetics, and media, it operates more like a sovereign state than a business.

They don’t just own companies—they own ecosystems. Their subsidiaries include rival companies that compete publicly while collaborating secretly. They shape markets, elections, ideologies, and even evolution itself.

Has a megatower in neo-toky named the Zaibatek Spire.

entries.name: z-media
entries.content:
Z-Media Group, one of Zaibatek's divisions.

Controls multiple news networks, influencers, and entertainment platforms.

Develops AI-generated propaganda, immersive VR shows, and pop culture campaigns to guide public opinion.

entries.name: SHS
entries.content:
Internal Motto:
“If it moves, we engineered it. If it kills, we perfected it.”

Corporate Overview:
Shinkuro Heavy Systems (SHS) is a mega-industrial conglomerate responsible for designing and producing:

Urban infrastructure
Autonomous weapon systems
Construction drones
Armored vehicles
Smart highways
Heavy duty mechs


They are the skeleton of the  world: its walls, its war machines, its veins of steel and smart concrete.

SHS is also the primary contractor for several corporate and national military forces, developing next-gen combat mechs, exosuits, riot suppression gear, and fortress-scale AI firebases.

entries.name: BlackZone
entries.content:
A remote facility where kaiju-class yokai mutations are studied and controlled .

Funding from Zaibatek suspected.

entries.name: ONI.Bio
entries.content:
Publicly branded as “Organic Neural Integration”

ONI.bio was a rogue-tier biotech facility operating under a string of shell companies with ties to Zaibatek, Kairosyn, and Shinkuro, but ultimately abandoned by all three when their experiments reached “ethically radioactive” territory.

Located in the industrial outskirts of Neo-Osaka, the lab was hidden behind a false facade: officially a Neural Integration testing site, in reality a place of unregulated ninkai experimentation, particularly on oni hybrids—for use as military assets

Now a crumbling, scorched facility, choked by overgrown red ivy, smashed one-way glass, and deactivated security mechs after the oni riots.

entries.name: HexaCorp
entries.content:
HexaCorp is the decentralized corporate-tech collective formed from six elite thinktanks and black labs that refused to be acquired by Zaibatek over two decades ago. They merged instead—forming a fractal mega-entity built on radical innovation and autonomy.

Unlike Zaibatek, which centralizes control, HexaCorp works in cellular, semi-autonomous clusters—each of its six divisions operates like a sovereign entity.

HexaNeurolink - Division of Neurotechnology
HexaGenyx - Division of Genetics
SpaceHex - Division of space exploration and space mining
HexaPhantom - Division of Cyber-Defense
EnerHex - Division of Exotic Energy
HexAI - Division of AI development

entries.name: Nekomata

Also, they tend to be very good looking.

They are one of the most popular Ninkai alongside nekomatas, since they just look like regular people for the most part. Also, they tend to be very good looking.

entries.content: The genome mutation for this kind of ninkai was made specifically with military uses in mind, this makes Onis be the most feared Ninkai race. Their are very reclusive, and tend to keep to their own. Due to this, they have their own culture. They are very open sexually with eachother.  Most now live in scattered, hidden mountain communities, steeped in older traditions, refusing neural augmentation and corporate technology.

entries.name: Oni purge
entries.content:
Timeframe:
Occurred roughly 30 years before the current era.

Spanned a decade of escalating legal restrictions, cybernetic tagging, surveillance, and forced relocation—culminating in armed displacement campaigns.

The Oni Purges were a systematic, state-sanctioned and corporate-supported effort to marginalize, exile, and eradicate oni from urban society. Corps had envitioned Onis to be soldiers, and as such, deemed too dangerous and too risky to their own interest to be left alone.

It began with fearmongering and propaganda around oni-related violence—many of which were staged, misattributed, or exacerbated by forced mutation experiments gone wrong (like those from ONI.bio or Kairosyn). Media outlets, many under Zaibatek’s influence, labeled oni as:

Emotionally unstable

Psychically dangerous

Incompatible with modern, posthuman society

“You can give an oni a neural net, but you’ll never take the monster out of its blood.” – Zaibatek-affiliated pundit
